text:
Anya (CS): Quick capture from MedLogic onboarding call — main asks & risks: 1) per-route cost caps (they run nightly bulk embeddings), 2) console lacks retry/error tracing for dev/SRE, 3) embedding quality drops on long OCR'd reports, 4) they want a one-page chunking & cleanup checklist. They signaled concern about renewal if infra risks persist.

Ravi - PM: solid notes. Can we get a reproducible sample for the embedding case and frequency of KMS/retry errors?

Anya (CS): dropped sample to CS-7744 and linked transcript. snippet: ```{"report_id":"ML-09","chars":10200}``` customer said recall started dropping after ~7k tokens.

Omid (Support): found two related tickets this month (INC-3388, INC-3399). I'll attach anonymized payloads and add severity tags.

Claire (Eng): initial suspect = chunking + OCR noise. If samples are available I can spin a repro job. Interim recommendation might be 1k-2k token chunks with 15-25% overlap and light header/footer stripping.

Noah (Docs): I can author a one-pager with example chunking configs, overlap %, and simple OCR cleanup steps. Low lift.

Anya (CS): csbot logged: "customer_signal: MedLogic - feature_ask/CS-7744" link: https://redwood.atlassian/CS-7744

csbot: New customer signal recorded: CS-7744 (MedLogic). Priority: revenue-risk candidate.

Ravi - PM: proposed prioritization: 1) route-level cost caps (pilot offering), 2) retry/error visibility in Console (observability SLO), 3) embeddings repro + guidance, 4) publish docs checklist. Agree?

Omid (Support): agree. I'll surface counts of similar embedding tickets during the groom.

Claire (Eng): I'll take the repro spike (owner). Est 1 week to reproduce + quick experiments. If chunking is root cause, we can roll guidance same week. If it's model/encoder behavior, longer timeline.

Anya (CS): I'll send MedLogic a short note: "we're opening a pilot to add route caps + will share a short best-practices doc this week. Engineering will run a quick spike and we'll follow up with timelines."

Ravi - PM: action items: Claire -> repro (owner). Noah -> docs checklist. Omid -> attach tickets + add severity tags. Anya -> customer comms + schedule 20-min groom. I'll scope route-cap UI + billing instrumentation in that groom.

Noah (Docs): draft ready by EOD tomorrow and will include config snippets for our SDK and Console examples.

Omid (Support): tagging CS-7744 [revenue-risk]. Attaching INC-3388, INC-3399 samples now.

csbot: Label update: CS-7744 tagged [revenue-risk, onboarding-risk].

Claire (Eng): will post initial repro notes in CS-7744 when I start.

Anya (CS): thanks team — keeping this tight since customer asked for timelines. If anyone feels the guide should be deprioritized in favor of immediate engineering work, speak up now.

Ravi - PM: keep both moving; guide protects customers while we spike. :rocket:
